title: Gangs
description: Optional undercrew choice. Small groups of unnamed NPCs that perform basic tasks during journeys.

options.name: Spear-Fishers
options.description: Tasked with plucking insects and small mammals from the sea as the ship travels.
options.special: Automatically acquire one normal specimen when you drop anchor.

options.name: Magnet-Fishers
options.description: Laconic scavengers that prefer the comfort of the deckside to the embrace of the waves.
options.special: Automatically acquire one normal piece of salvage when you drop anchor.

options.name: Stargazers
options.special: Automatically acquire one normal whisper when you drop anchor.

options.name: Cartographers
options.description: Navigator-adjuncts tasked with keeping a record of the ship's journeys and surroundings.
options.special: Automatically acquire one normal chart when you drop anchor.

options.name: Deck Engineers
options.description: Tasked with keeping the ship in working condition.
options.special: Automatically clear one mark from any damaged ship rating when you drop anchor.

options.name: Bonesaw Troupe
options.description: Amateur surgeons eager to keep the crew in some semblance of good health.
options.special: A single crewmember can heal a mark from any damaged trait or injury when you drop anchor.

options.name: Tinker Troupe
options.description: Amateur metalworkers and clothiers, maintaining the crew's possessions as best they can.
options.special: A single crewmember can repair a mark from any gear when you drop anchor.

options.name: Scholars
options.description: Students working on unlocking the mysteries of the sea.
options.special: You learn a secret of the surrounding waves whenever you drop anchor, supplied by the Firefly.

options.name: Marauders
options.description: Rough sorts that take the protection of the ship and the celebrations after a fight extremely seriously.
options.special: Fight in close combat to defend the ship, dealing CQ Blunt, Keen, or Spike damage.

options.name: Picaros
options.description: Adventurous slingers armed with crossbows, pistols, and blunderbusses.
options.special: Fight at range to defend the ship, dealing LR Blunt, Keen, or Spike damage.
